title: Where the Water Goes
subtitle: 气候变化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）
meta: 主题语境：气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）　|　核心词汇：place　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 place 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The flood that changed our village took ① place on a Tuesday in June. The water rose in two hours and stayed for five days. ② In the first place nobody believed the rain would last: my grandmother had said the same thing every June for sixty years, and she had usually been right. This time she was not.

Our village sits at the lowest ③ place in the valley, so whatever falls on three hills eventually comes down to us. Nobody wanted to lose a place to put rice, either. After the water went down, the county sent an engineer who walked the whole bank twice. ④ In place of higher sandbags, which everyone demanded, he insisted on digging a second channel and letting one field flood instead.

That plan was unpopular. The meeting in the old school hall lasted four hours. The engineer came to our ⑤ place at six o'clock the next morning, before anybody had eaten, and drew his channel in the dust with a stick. For a week we ⑥ placed boards and stones along the bank. My grandmother watched us from her doorway and said nothing at all.

Then the rains returned, and the second channel filled exactly as he had drawn it. Nothing else needed doing; the water simply went where somebody had decided in advance that it should go. Two months later the same engineer ⑦ found a place at the county water office and came to live among us. I could not ⑧ place him at first: the man in the clean shirt was not the man with the stick.

'⑨ Whose place floods now?' I asked him once. 'Mine,' he said, 'and that is the ⑩ place it should be — smaller losses, shared by everybody.' Every place has its own water problem, he added, and its own answer. I have thought about that sentence ever since. Climate policy is not only about ice caps and distant islands; it is also about deciding out loud, before the rain comes, where the water will go.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 地方；地点；位置
B. n. 职位；工作（find/get a place）
C. n. 住所；家里（at / to one's place）
E. v. 认出；想起（can't place sb）
F. 固定搭配：take place 发生；举行
G. 固定搭配：in place of 代替；而不是
H. 固定搭配：in the first place 起初；首先

items.q: took place on a Tuesday in June
In the first place nobody believed the rain would last
at the lowest place in the valley
came to our place at six o'clock
we placed boards and stones along the bank
found a place at the county water office
I could not place him at first
that is the place it should be

answers.why: take place 意为“发生”，是不及物短语，主语为洪水这一事件。
in the first place 意为“起初；首先”，此处指一开始没人相信雨会一直下。
被 lowest 修饰且后接 in the valley，指村庄所处的具体位置，是名词“地点”。
in place of＋被替代物，意为“代替、而不是”，工程师提议挖渠而非加高沙袋。
come to one's place 意为“到某人家来”，与后面的 my grandmother watched us 相呼应。
place＋宾语＋介词短语，是动词“放置”，指把木板和石块沿河岸摆好。
find a place 指“谋得一个职位”，宾语项目是县水利局的岗位。
place sb 意为“认出某人、想起是谁”，常用于否定；穿衣整洁的他令作者对不上号。
whose place 指“谁的地方（田地、住处）”，在此问的是现在轮到哪一块地被淹。
the place it should be 指“它应在的地方”，工程师解释让水淹的位置本该如此。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 会议在老学校礼堂举行。（take place）
起初，没有人相信这场雨会一直下。（in the first place）
我们村位于山谷最低的地方。（place n.）
我们没有把沙袋加高，而是挖了第二条水渠。（in place of）
第二天早上六点，那位工程师来到了我家。（come to one's place）
我一时没能认出他。（place v.）
answers: The meeting took place in the old school hall.
In the first place, nobody believed the rain would last.
Our village sits at the lowest place in the valley.
In place of higher sandbags, we dug a second channel.
The engineer came to our place at six o'clock the next morning.
I could not place him at first.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 place 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: The flood that changed our village took place on a Tuesday in June.
In the first place nobody believed the rain would last, though our village sits at the lowest place in the valley.
In place of higher sandbags, the engineer insisted on digging a second channel.
He came to our place at six in the morning and drew his plan in the dust with a stick.
Later he found a place at the county water office, and I could not place him at first in his clean shirt.
Every place has its own water problem and its own answer, decided long before the rain arrives.
